notes: Curated 2026-11-09 from the Go console tables. Verify after 2026-12-09: Go lineups and promo multipliers change often.

Each model has a monthly dollar cap. 20% of it is available per rolling 5 hours and 50% per week; the monthly cap is 100%. Values below are Go and Go Plus monthly caps; Go Teams runs 5 USD/month higher on every model unless a model lists its own teams value.
These caps are the fallback while the Console has not been checked. With a Console API key the island reads the account's exact allowances instead; nothing is sent anywhere else.
Matching is case-insensitive on the normalized model id, so display names like GPT 6 Luna match gpt-6-luna.
